profile.headline: Managing Partner and Principal Software Engineer

positions.title: Managing Partner and Principal Software Engineer
Development Manager
positions.description:
Provide leadership and guidance to coach, motivate, and lead team members to their optimum performance levels and career development

Ensure that teams have appropriate product and technical specifications, direction, and resources to deliver products effectively

Track and report the status of projects on various teams

Serve as the technical lead in all client meetings
